decision.reason: Exact index-valued curl. Use merge-split cancellation and the structural isomorphisms, then evaluate the reverse cup followed by the multiplication cap as the subgroup-index scalar.
decision.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G δ α hδ hα d a S finite up loopUp loopDown straight cup middle cap curl
  have hmid :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mergeUp Complex a d).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.splitUp Complex a d) =
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a).tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d)) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp a d
  have hcup :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.reverseCup Complex d finite).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.multiplicationCap Complex d) =
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.regular H)).scale
        (S.index : Complex) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup_multiplicationCap d finite
  simp only [curl, middle, cup, cap, straight, up, loopDown, loopUp,
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval, hmid, MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d) Complex),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_id, ← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d) Complex),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.unassociate_associate, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)).horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.reverseCup Complex d finite)),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical, hcup,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_right, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_right, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.insertRightUnit_rightUnit]
